text:
Marta Rodriguez: FYI — got a P1 from acme-inc. They saw sudden 429s + high latency during this morning's marketing spike. sample req id: req_8f7c2d. Error payload: {"error":"rate_exceeded","retry_after":30}. Can SRE triage & repro?
Amit Patel: adding to queue. Do we have RPM/TPM for that org? If not, can support export 1m histogram + the auth token they used (scrub org ids)?
Marta Rodriguez: pulled logs 2026-03-12 10:14-10:28 UTC. Attached sample lines (scrubbed). Avg ~220 req/min for ~7m with bursts up to ~1100 rpm for ~30s. Auth key is project key, not org-admin. No billing alerts.
Jordan Lee: quick note on burst policy: per-key token-bucket with reservoir proportional to steady-window (config). Short spikes still 429 if backend batching can't absorb. KV prefix cache helps repeated prompts but not new variants.
Nikhil Sharma: can repro internally. I'll spin up vegeta on staging with canary api key + test org. Pattern: baseline 220 rpm, ramp to 1100 rpm for 30s, back down.
Amit Patel: vegeta snippet for quick repro (replace API_KEY/URL):
```bash
# baseline
echo "GET https://api.staging.redwood.ai/v1/generate" | vegeta attack -rate=220 -duration=7m | vegeta report
# spike
echo "GET https://api.staging.redwood.ai/v1/generate" | vegeta attack -rate=1100 -duration=30s | vegeta report
```
Marta Rodriguez: running baseline now on staging with canary key, will post logs.
SupportBot: Customer acme-inc (tier: standard) — no billing blocks; last invoice 2026-02-28. Quota config: per-key default=100 RPM, burst_window=5m, burst_multiplier=3 (org overrides possible).
Luis Gomez: billing note: standard plan—no auto-throttles for unpaid invoices here. Commits/reserved could differ.
Marta Rodriguez: ran vegeta — saw 429s start at spike start; ~18% 429 rate during 30s. Attached snippets: "rate_exceeded" + backend latency spikes in token-queue handling.
Jordan Lee: proposed test matrix to pick sane defaults:
- Profile A (steady): 1-5m @ 50-300 rpm measure p50/p95/p99 + error rate
- Profile B (short spike): baseline 5m then x3/x5/x10 spike for 15-60s
- Profile C (long burst): baseline then elevated load for 5-15m to exercise reservoir
Metrics: 429 rate, 5xx rate, p95 end-to-end, token queue depth, batch size distribution.
Nikhil Sharma: I'll wire a Jenkins job to run these against staging and upload CSV to S3. Flags: with/without prefix cache, different quant settings to rule out kernel thrash.
Amit Patel: draft operational thresholds:
- free/preview: 60 RPM, burst_window=1m, burst_mult=2
- standard: 120 RPM, burst_window=5m, burst_mult=3
- enterprise: negotiated; default ~600 RPM + controlled burst + canary fallback
Need data from the harness to validate.
Marta Rodriguez: what can support tell customer now?
Jordan Lee: immediate mitigations:
- exponential backoff with jitter on 429s and obey Retry-After
- if policy allows, shard across multiple API keys
- reduce tokens per request (shorter prompts)
- request temporary quota bump via SRE runbook — pre-approved 2x for 1h if needed
Luis Gomez: also log billing check; for persistent throughput propose Dedicated/reserved.
Marta Rodriguez: Nikhil, run harness now. Need rough numbers for customer in 2h.
Nikhil Sharma: kicked off jenkins/job/infra-load-tests/quick-spike-183912 on staging with canary key. Will post CSV + p95/p99 in ~45m.
DeployBot: staging test harness deploy acknowledged (build #5427). No prod deploys. :rocket:
Amit Patel: once CSVs exist we'll pick conservative config: largest RPM where 429 <0.5% for short x3 spike and p95 <500ms. Also check p99.
Marta Rodriguez: thanks. I'll update customer with mitigations and status.
Jordan Lee: action items: (1) SRE run 3 profiles + add to /kb/quotas/load-tests (2) Product review default burst_mult for standard vs free (3) Support add customer guidance snippet for 429 + Retry-After.
Marta Rodriguez: added note to ticket and scheduled async update in 1h.
Nikhil Sharma: upload complete — s3://redwood-internal/loadtests/183912_quick_spike.csv. Quick summary: standard config (120 RPM, burst_mult=3) produced 12% 429s for 30s x5 spike; raising burst_window to 10m dropped 429s to 2% but increased p95 by ~80ms. Opening PR with graphs.
Marta Rodriguez: copied summary into ticket and recommending temporary 2x quota while we finalise defaults.
Jordan Lee: drafting internal note with recommended conservative defaults + graphs. PR expected by EOD.
Marta Rodriguez: closing loop for now. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
